reason: $59 a month is a lot when library storytime and the parks are free, and money is tight since daycare went up. I might try a drop-in once it opens, but I wouldn't commit to a membership.
objection: I can get most of this for free at the library and parks, so $59 every month for one child feels hard to justify. I also don't know yet if my kids would actually like it.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit, or a membership around $25-30 a month that I could cancel anytime.
